title: One local finite constant cone lowers the cohomological interval
statement: Let C be a small site with precoverage J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], B a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and assume the derived categories of ModuleCat(B)-valued sheaves on C/V exist for all V [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Let U be an object, K an object of D(Sh(C/U,Mod_B)), and a<b integers. Assume H^q(K)=0 outside [a,b] [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] and, for every q and arrow V to U, the restriction of H^q(K) to C/V becomes a constant finite B-module sheaf after a J-cover of V [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. There is a J-cover {V_i to U}, finite B-modules M_i, and objects L_i of D(Sh(C/V_i,Mod_B)) whose cohomology vanishes outside [a,b-1] and satisfies the same finite local constant condition on every further slice, together with distinguished triangles K|_(V_i) to L_i to constant(M_i) in degree b-1 to (K|_(V_i))[1] [def-weil-triangulated-category]. No tower, induction hypothesis, chain realization or whole-interval model is asserted.

proof.text: For each member of a cover trivializing H^b(K), choose a finite free coefficient module mapping onto the trivialized finite module. Use an arbitrary cochain representative of the restricted object and the epimorphism from cycles to homology; upper truncation is unnecessary. The private local_free_lift proof intersects the image sieves of the finitely many basis vectors, extracts a J-cover, and uses the terminal-object constant-sheaf adjunction on each flat slice to lift the generators. Compatibility of sheafification with restriction proves the lifting equation.

proof.text: Include the lifted cycles in the restricted representative to obtain a chain map from the finite free constant single complex in degree b. The homology projection and the cycles comparison for an exact functor show that this map is epic on H^b. Localize it, transport along the representative isomorphism, flatten the derived restriction composition, and compose the two covers. This is the proved private local_top_epi lemma.

source.place: Tag 094G, proof of lemma-locally-constant, finite free top-cohomology lifting and the cohomology of its cone

proof.text: Complete the local top epimorphism to a distinguished triangle S -> K|V -> L -> S[1]. For the finite locally constant predicate on C/V, use the module-valued weak Serre bridge. The proved source-library homologyProperty theorem then gives finite locally constant cohomology for L, using constant single objects and exact restriction. The exact segment H^q(K|V) -> H^q(L) -> H^(q+1)(S) forces vanishing outside [a,b-1]: for q != b both outer terms vanish, while for q=b the first map is zero because H^b(S -> K|V) is epic and the second target vanishes. Rotate and use the single-functor shift isomorphism S[1] = constant(F)[b-1] to obtain the required triangle.

mathlib_searches.query: Locally lift a finite free constant sheaf to a bounded derived complex to kill top cohomology and obtain a cone of smaller amplitude
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: mappingCone, mappingCone.lift and related cochain constructors, plus global sections cones. These construct formal cones but do not supply local finite-free top generators or finite locally constant cohomology of the cone.

mathlib_searches.query: A bounded derived object with finite locally constant cohomology locally has a morphism from a finite free constant sheaf in its top degree whose cone has smaller cohomological amplitude
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: derived fractions, support of Q and vanishing against projective/injective single objects. No local finite-free cone reduction on a site.
HomologySequence.epi_homologyMap_mor₁_iff and epi_homologyMap_mor₂_iff give exactness consequences; neither constructs the local morphism or its finite locally constant cone.

theorem exists_site_finite_constant_cone_step
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition]
    [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    [∀ U : C, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B))] :
    let ρ := fun {U V : C} (f : V ⟶ U) ↦
      @Functor.mapDerivedCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (J.toGrothendieck.overMapPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) f)
        (Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _) _
        ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ PreservesColimitsOfSize.preservesColimitsOfShape
          (self := Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits
            (Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous (Over.map f) (ModuleCat.{u} B)
              (J.toGrothendieck.over V) (J.toGrothendieck.over U)))⟩
    ∀ (U : C) (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B)))
      (a b : ℤ) (hab : a < b)
      (hvan : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj K))
      (hloc : ∀ (q : ℤ) (V : C) (g : V ⟶ U),
        ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → C) (f : ∀ i : I, W i ⟶ V),
          Presieve.ofArrows W f ∈ J V ∧
          ∀ i : I, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} B, Module.Finite B M ∧ Nonempty
            ((J.toGrothendieck.overMapPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) (f i ≫ g)).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over U) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj K) ≅
              (constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj M)),
      ∃ (I : Type u) (V : I → C) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U),
        Presieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U ∧
        ∀ i : I, ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u} B), Module.Finite B M ∧
          ∃ (L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B))),
            (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b - 1 < q → IsZero
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj L)) ∧
            (∀ (q : ℤ) (W : C) (g : W ⟶ V i),
              ∃ (T : Type u) (Z : T → C) (h : ∀ t : T, Z t ⟶ W),
                Presieve.ofArrows Z h ∈ J W ∧
                ∀ t : T, ∃ N : ModuleCat.{u} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
                  ((J.toGrothendieck.overMapPullback (ModuleCat.{u} B) (h t ≫ g)).obj
                    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
                      (Sheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)) q).obj L) ≅
                    (constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (Z t)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj N)) ∧
            ∃ (iK : (ρ (f i)).obj K ⟶ L)
              (δ : L ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ (b - 1)).obj
                  ((constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj M)))
              (j : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
                ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ (b - 1)).obj
                  ((constantSheaf (J.toGrothendieck.over (V i)) (ModuleCat.{u} B)).obj M)) ⟶
                    ((ρ (f i)).obj K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
              Triangle.mk iK δ j ∈ distTriang _
